algorithm: ACT (Action Chunking with Transformers) BC policy, trained on sim teleoperation demonstrations augmented via Sensitivity-Aware Kinematics Augmentation, automatic curriculum learning, and action aggregation, fine-tuned on real demonstrations
success_criterion: Pick and Place: object properly placed onto the red plate; Rotate: valve rotated 720 degrees; Pour: all four boxes poured into the bowl
headline_metric: real-robot task success rate (x/20 trials) vs. visual-pretraining baselines (R3M/PVR/MVP)
headline_value: Level 1 (in-domain): Pick-Place Mustard Bottle 7/20 (Ours) vs. R3M 2/20, PVR 4/20, MVP 2/20; Pick-Place Tomato Can 14/20 vs. R3M 7/20; Rotate 15/20 vs. MVP 8/20 (best baseline); average performance boost of 31.67% at Level 1 (Table 1)
note_gaps: the real-demo count is stated inconsistently (a '3-minute trajectory' in Sec. 3.1 vs. '15 real-world demonstrations' in Appendix B.3); the human-to-robot retargeting mapping itself is delegated entirely to a cited teleoperation system and never described or ablated in this paper; Appendix B.1/B.2's 'human play data' description contradicts the main text's task-directed teleoperation framing and appears to be an extraction artifact
operator_interface: vision-based teleoperation (single RealSense camera observing operator hand motion, real-time hand detection and retargeting via a cited third-party system), not a glove or headset
retargeting_objective: delegated entirely to the cited third-party teleoperation system; CyberDemo does not describe or modify the human-to-robot mapping itself
